description: Na₂CeWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.93 Å. Ce is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ce-O bond lengths are 2.22 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.92 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Ce, and one W atom.
